review_scope: Independent read-only review of rt-R2-created-read-contract-1803; no Runtime, Agent, App, test, schema, generated-file, pin, provider, or fixture changes
verdict_basis: The author assessment materially overstates the contract limit. C0 defines sequential public operand/change resolution and C0c uses subsequent qualified operand, not subsequent command. It does not thereby require acceptance of every raw post-handler provider read inside the creating command.

approved_contract_interpretation.request_reads: Evaluate at batch input and apply conservatively to every step (C0:112-120, 614-616).
approved_contract_interpretation.step_reads: Evaluate immediately before the step's first command, after preceding executed changes; a later step can consume an earlier step's output (C0:118-123, 614-616, 650-651).
approved_contract_interpretation.public_command_operands_and_changes: Resolve each command operand/change at its sequential input, including preceding creations/removals; a future creation cannot satisfy an earlier lookup and a detached image cannot satisfy a later lookup (C0:314-322).
approved_contract_interpretation.same_batch_creation_visibility: Semantic closure creation is performed by provider commands; subsequent patches in the same batch may address their created roots (C0:356-367). C0c's verified intermediate images must be exposed before a subsequent qualified operand uses them, or unsupported input may be refused (C0c:2825-2837). 'Operand' is not limited to a separately numbered command.
approved_contract_interpretation.captured_provider_reads: Provider semantic reads remain exact recorder facts with their observed state/evaluation boundary and contribute to dependencies/conflicts (C0:112-155, 603-612). The contract does not say that a raw read made after the handler's own write is automatically a public command-input guard or that Runtime must accept it without an authenticated intra-command boundary.
approved_contract_interpretation.own_writes: Earlier steps are not intervening publications, but that conflict/undo rule does not grant a caller or provider a forged physical identity or an unauthenticated same-command child boundary (C0:650-661, 1612-1636).

contract_citations.claim: Each operand/change is evaluated sequentially, including preceding creations/removals.
Subsequent patches in the same batch may address roots created by semantic commands.
C0c names a subsequent qualified operand and permits refusal when the intermediate image is unsupported.
Captured semantic reads are preserved as provider facts and dependencies, with evaluation boundaries retained.

runtime_current.fact: The first command input starts from the source boundary; command_output projects a later command input from prior authenticated command records.
validate_step resolves each captured record read against its command_boundary. The generic created exception only skips an exact created root with an absent state.
Occurrence child aliases require exactly one occurrence row in the supplied boundary before following shot/internal authenticated edges; an absent created occurrence is rejected at line 156.
The existing projector is explicitly for a later command in the same step; it constructs an authenticated intermediate view from creation writes and following-command bindings.
Physical bindings are checked against their assigned input/effect/materialization boundary; no general same-command post-creation child exception exists.
Prepared records/canonical output reach authenticated Runtime validation before acceptance.

finish(capture=True) projects public command read guards from command_input while retaining the staged record reads. This confirms the App 1753 wording correction.
The graph fixture creates roots, then selects/reads/binds/writes occurrence:new-occ/clip:title inside one handler/command.
The failing graph path invokes that one create command, while the root-only control does not add child aliases.

source_owner_and_limits.owner: Runtime authenticated closure validator owns the observed refusal; the current source's narrow sequential projector covers a following command, not arbitrary raw reads after writes within one handler.
source_owner_and_limits.producer_limit: The current Agent graph producer emits staged child reads/bindings with no authenticated intra-command read ordinal or intermediate closure record. Its public command guards are pre-command projections, as required by the App 1753 correction.
source_owner_and_limits.contract_result: The public doc.patch/semantic-command sequential behavior is already defined by C0. A producer can satisfy it by making the child access a subsequent qualified public operand/patch with the required authenticated intermediate binding, or by refusing unsupported input. No Runtime trust widening follows from the current guard refusal.
